patient_actor_hidden.History: The patient has been brought in by her boyfriend due to a 4-month history of feeling persistently sad. She reports that she has had significant trouble sleeping and eating during this period, and her ability to concentrate at work has deteriorated. She describes a feeling of emptiness and experiences auditory hallucinations, specifically voices telling her she is worthless. These hallucinations began 7 months ago, initially with the voices mocking her. The patient denies using alcohol or illicit substances.

Secondary_Symptoms: Perceptual disturbances (attention directed towards non-apparent stimuli)

patient_actor_hidden.Social_History: Denies alcohol or illicit drug use. No other relevant social history provided.
patient_actor_hidden.Review_of_Systems: She denies any other systemic symptoms.

objective_for_doctor: Assess and diagnose the patient presenting with sadness, auditory hallucinations, and difficulties in concentrating and functioning at work.

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: “I’ve been feeling persistently very sad for about four months, and I’ve had trouble sleeping and eating that whole time. Lately it’s been affecting my focus at work, and I sometimes hear voices that tell me I’m worthless.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any areas of your skin that look scratched, rubbed raw, or have small open spots (excoriations)?
turns.patient_answer: “I haven’t noticed any scratched or rubbed-raw skin or any small open spots. I mostly feel sad, can’t sleep or eat well, and I hear voices that tell me I’m worthless.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any episodes where you stop breathing or you have pauses in breathing during sleep (for example, someone says you stop, or you wake up gasping)?
turns.patient_answer: “I don’t think I’ve had any pauses in breathing or episodes where I stop breathing, and I haven’t woken up gasping—my main issue is that I can’t fall asleep and I sleep poorly.”

turns.doctor_question: After your minor injury, have you noticed any signs that a bone might be broken—such as severe pain, swelling, bruising, deformity, or trouble using the injured area? (Yes/No)
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any injury or symptoms like severe pain, swelling, bruising, deformity, or trouble using any area—I’ve mostly been dealing with feeling very sad, poor sleep and appetite, and hearing voices that tell me I’m worthless.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any redness or warmth on your **left wrist** (the skin looking red compared to the other side)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any redness or warmth on my left wrist—or any other changes in the skin. I’ve mainly been dealing with feeling very sad, not sleeping or eating well, and hearing voices that tell me I’m worthless.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any bruising on your chest wall (for example, dark or discolored areas on the chest), especially after an injury, coughing, or vomiting?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any bruising on my chest wall. I haven’t had any injuries, heavy coughing, or vomiting—my main problems are persistent sadness, poor sleep and appetite, and hearing voices telling me I’m worthless.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been urinating much more than usual lately—like needing to go to the bathroom more often or producing a larger amount of urine?
turns.patient_answer: “I don’t think I’ve been urinating more than usual—I haven’t noticed needing to go to the bathroom more often or producing more urine.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you used any substances such as alcohol, tobacco, cannabis, opioids, stimulants, or other drugs in the past or currently?
turns.patient_answer: “I deny using alcohol or any illicit drugs, and I’m not using tobacco, cannabis, opioids, or stimulants either—nothing like that current or in the past.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you had any trouble controlling your urine—such as leaking or not making it to the bathroom in time? (yes or no)
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any trouble controlling my urine—I haven’t noticed leaking or urgency that I can’t make it to the bathroom in time.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any new or changing skin lesion—such as a new spot, sore, bump, mole change, or area that’s growing, bleeding, or not healing? (Yes/No)
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any new or changing skin lesions—no new spots, sores, bumps, or moles that are growing, bleeding, or not healing.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you had any nosebleeds recently (even a small amount), or blood coming from your nose?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any nosebleeds or blood coming from my nose recently.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any rash on your trunk (chest, back, or belly)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any rash on my trunk—no spots or areas of irritation on my chest, back, or belly. My focus has mainly been on feeling persistently sad, sleeping and eating poorly, and hearing voices that tell me I’m worthless.”
